source_lineage.retained_baselines: all_public_baselines_metrics.csv, assembled from the 2026-09-16 new_standard priority-2 run

blocking_gaps: The visualised public baseline values and Expert values do not come from one single frozen run directory or one single manifest.
The public baseline values are single-seed (42), whereas transformer_rerun_v3 is three-seed and only reruns Transformer; the all-model public table is not a three-seed common-protocol table.

protocol_for_human_review.json records only a model list and status; it does not freeze public unit folds, data manifests, target construction, checkpoint rule, software/environment checksum, or per-run provenance.
The upstream priority-2 protocol still announces LSTM, BiLSTM and IMDSSN, although the later human-review list removes them; this is not a single internally consistent protocol.

The Expert rows in the merged public file are taken from expert_aligned_aep_gated_causal in the new-standard run, not from the three-seed transformer_rerun_v3 directory, so the public table mixes provenance and training settings.
No frozen checksum manifest covers the public source code, public data processing, folds and merged result together.

proposed_approval_run.device_split: nested physical-device folds, identical folds for every model and seed
proposed_approval_run.target: RUL in cycles using the dataset endpoint; public-data target and endpoint manifests frozen before training
proposed_approval_run.prefix_policy: same observed prefix endpoints across models; maximum 20 prefixes per unit; sequence length 128
proposed_approval_run.checkpoint_selection: minimum validation MSE only; test never used
proposed_approval_run.outputs: prediction-level CSV, per-device metrics, reliability, computational cost, environment, folds, manifests and SHA-256 checksums
proposed_approval_run.approval_gate: Do not execute until human approval is recorded.
